method: Input volume MEASURED via rescore_stored_packs.estimate_speech (relevance.score_payload + _SCORE_SYSTEM) over the step-2 target claims on the shipping head; output volume priced from truthbot.costs. NO calls made.
scope_note: score_evidence rewrites a WHOLE pack, so the priced unit is every item on the target claims, not only the null ones.

1_same_scorer_baseline.why: B1a already scored these exact items with this exact model on this exact text and abstained; re-running it mostly buys the same nulls back. Priced for completeness, not offered as a fix.

2_stronger_scorer.lane: UNCONFIRMED — verify proxy serves it; if off-proxy the figure is ESTIMATE-ONLY with no ledger truth
2_stronger_scorer.why: The first option that could actually move an abstention. The number is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE extrapolation: costs.py's per-item output load is calibrated on claude-haiku only.

3_fuller_text.why: Most likely to resolve a stance (the abstentions look like snippet-granularity limits at ~133 chars), but it needs a document-fetch pass of unknown volume. A number here would be invented.

pilot_suggestion.note: Run ONE speech first and measure how many nulls actually resolve, before committing the full 23. Yield is the unpriced unknown and some abstentions are correct.

uncertainty: Uncertainty: token counts are NOT a tokenizer run — no tokenizer is installed and this path is $0/offline. 3.13 chars/token and 32.5 output tokens/item are BACK-SOLVED from ledger actuals (haiku-score-2026-08-09): the B1a run ($1.0632) and the B2 run ($0.5405), 2026-08-08, model claude-haiku, over 10 per-speech proxy_key_spend deltas. Back-test residuals +1.1% (B1a) and -0.3% (B2). This is a FIT TO TWO RUNS ON ONE MODEL, not a measured law: expect +/-5% on a whole run and +/-20% on a single speech, and nothing at all outside this prompt family. Haiku is ON-PROXY, so the funded run's real cost stays LEDGER-TRUE (proxy_key_spend) and the breaker, not this number, is what stops the spend.
spend_authorization: NONE. This is an estimate only; no calls were made and none are authorized by this artifact. A funded run needs an explicit owner budget cap, which the breaker — not this number — enforces.
